:::{.info-card .info-card--course-content}
<div class="info-card__header">
  <span class="info-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <img src="img/icons/book-stack.svg" alt="" class="info-card__icon-img">
  </span>
  <h2 class="info-card__heading">Training content</h2>
</div>

:::{.card-copy}
The focus of the workshop is to provide training in some of the most recent developments of CryoET and STA data processing using for instance **nextPYP**, **TomoBEAR**, **Warp/M**, taught by the developers themselves.

The workshop provides hands-on training in CryoET and STA encompassing all stages of the pipeline.

No previous experience is required. Participants are required to bring their own laptops with mouse to the workshop.
:::
:::

:::{.info-card .info-card--learning-outcomes}
<div class="info-card__header">
  <span class="info-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <img src="img/icons/target.svg" alt="" class="info-card__icon-img">
  </span>
  <h2 class="info-card__heading">Learning outcomes</h2>
</div>

:::{.card-copy}
1. Alignment and reconstruction of tilt series
2. Manual and automated particle picking
3. Archiving and cataloguing of tilt series, tomograms and annotations
4. Creation of subtomogram averaging projects
5. Advanced tools in subtomogram averaging
6. Classification methods
7. Creation of 3D maps
:::
:::
